example: Chapter 2, Example ex:equilibria_Lorenz (equilibrium of the Lorenz system)
problem: f(x) = (sigma (x2 - x1), rho x1 - x2 - x1 x3, -beta x3 + x1 x2)
norm: sup norm on R^3, induced operator norm (maximal absolute row sum)
